text: {"lessons":["Because I rarely check my account, I should set a simple regular review schedule instead of reacting only when a trade feels urgent.","I sold Stock E and Stock D for gains, but locking in a profit is not a goal by itself; I should compare each position’s outlook with the alternatives before selling.","Selling Stock A at a large loss was painful, but avoiding that feeling should not keep me invested; I should reassess its prospects objectively and apply the same standard to winners and losers."]}
